tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
    # Merge-blocking through the EXISTING legs: ci.yml test-core (dart test
    # runs it) and the pty-visual job (fa_omp_reg_visual_test.dart) both
    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1500
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1500
- **Title**: gh-1499 [PERF] buildContextLedger: memoized per-record entries + O(1) entryAtSeq — ~45x faster per-pass rebuilds, linear cold growth
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1499-context-ledger-index` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +337
- **Deletions**: -60
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T15:56:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T16:09:50Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1499

## Root cause

`buildContextLedger` is O(visible path) per call, and the expensive part of each entry — `estimateTokens`, preview flattening, the `isSyntheticUserText` scan — scales with the record's **content**. Every compaction pass (`_buildView`: judge hide loop, deterministic fallback, LRU re-hide, checkpoint walk) rebuilt the ledger over the whole visible path from scratch, so a marathon session re-processed its entire history on every pass (the profiled 2.0s mean / 58.8s max, 32 calls / 65s total). `RecordSeqIndex.seqOf` was already a map lookup; the real costs were per-record re-derivation plus the linear `entryAtSeq` scan (judge-pick validation, hide token accounting).

## Fix (main's shape preserved, minimal)

- **`LedgerEntryCache`** (ledger.dart): id-keyed memo of the derived entry scalars. The session file is append-only and record ids are stable, so seq/kind/tokens/preview/toolNames never change for a given id; a cache hit rewraps the **current** record instance, and a cached seq that no longer matches the live index recomputes (self-correcting). Ownership: one cache per ledger-rebuilding chain — a `StructuredCompactor` run, or a `CompactExpandController` (cleared when the live `Session` object changes, since ids are unique within a session only). `buildContextLedger`'s new `cache` param is optional — every other caller and test keeps byte-identical behavior.
- **`entryAtSeq`**: map lookup instead of a linear scan.

Ledger output is byte-equivalent — asserted warm-vs-cold entry-by-entry in the new guard, plus all 355 existing `test/compaction/` tests green.

## Before / after (standalone dart, synthetic tool-use turns ~1.5 KB result each)

| scenario | before (no memo) | after (memo) |
|---|---|---|
| cold build, 1k records | 54 ms | 54 ms (unchanged path) |
| cold build, 10k records | 424 ms (**×8, linear**) | 424 ms |
| 24 per-pass rebuilds over a 10k-record history | **9,777 ms** | **218 ms (~45×)** |

Issue acceptance: growth is linear (×8 per decade), max < 1s at 10k — and the compaction pattern (pass after pass over grown history) drops from ~10s to ~0.2s. The instrumentation caveat from the issue applies to absolute numbers, not the ratio.

## Regression guard

`test/compaction/structured_ledger_perf_test.dart` (core suite, ~1.5s total, generous CI-jitter bounds): cold-build linearity (30× ratio + 3s sanity ceiling at 10k), bounded incremental-rebuild marathon (24 cached passes < 2.5s — the pre-fix shape runs ~10s), warm-vs-cold byte-equivalence, seq-move self-correction, `clear()`.

## Interplay with PR #1458 (issue #1380 total recall)

Checked `feat/1380-recall`'s full diff before writing this: it reshapes the **obligations** ledger + session-wide search (`lib/src/session/obligations_ledger.dart`, `session_search*.dart`, CLI/prompt wiring) and **does not touch** `lib/src/compaction/structured/{ledger,engine,expand_tool}.dart` — zero file-level conflict expected with this branch. Semantic overlap is nil: #1458's classification consumes `isSyntheticUserText`, which this change calls but never alters; the two "ledgers" are unrelated structures. Merge order is free; whoever lands second rebases on the train as usual (no conflict expected either way). If #1458 lands first and wants the same memo for any future per-turn ledger rebuilds, `LedgerEntryCache` is the seam to reuse.

## Remaining (not in this PR)

- The per-pass `_projectedEntries` walk (`recordTokens`/`hiddenMarkerTokens` per record per pass) and `_refreshState`'s full re-projection are separate per-pass costs outside `buildContextLedger`; the memo does not cover them. Worth a follow-up profile pass.
- Cache memory is bounded by records-ever-visible (~300 bytes/record: ≤110-char preview + scalars) and dies with the run/controller.

+/// Issue #1499 — the ledger build's growth shape and rebuild cost.
+///
+/// Regression guard with GENEROUS bounds (CI runners jitter): the absolute
+/// ceilings are 10-30x the measured local costs, tight enough that the
+/// historical shape — every compaction pass re-tokenizing the whole visible
+/// history from scratch, plus linear `entryAtSeq` scans — fails them on a
+/// synthetic 10k-record session.
+library;
+
+import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/flutter_agent_harness.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/src/compaction/structured/ledger.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/src/compaction/structured/projection.dart';
+import 'package:test/test.dart';
+
+/// One tool-use turn: user ask, assistant tool-call carrier, giant result.
+/// ~1.5 KB of text per turn — realistic file-read sizes, heavy enough that
+/// re-tokenizing history dominates any bookkeeping loop.
+List<SessionRecord> _turns(int count, {int startIndex = 0}) => [
+  for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) ..._turn(startIndex + i),
+];
+
+List<SessionRecord> _turn(int i) {
+  final resultText = 'x.dart:${'line $i content. ' * 44}';
+  return [
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-u',
+      parentId: i == 0 ? null : 'r${i - 1}-t',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: UserMessage.text('turn $i: inspect the failing module'),
+    ),
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-a',
+      parentId: 'r$i-u',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: AssistantMessage(
+        content: [
+          TextContent(text: 'reading the module for turn $i'),
+          ToolCall(
+            id: 'c$i',
+            name: 'read',
+            arguments: {'path': 'lib/mod$i.dart', 'why': 'turn $i'},
+          ),
+        ],
+        api: 'anthropic-messages',
+        provider: 'p',
+        model: 'm1',
+        usage: Usage.zero,
+        stopReason: StopReason.stop,
+        timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      ),
+    ),
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-t',
+      parentId: 'r$i-a',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: ToolResultMessage(
+        toolCallId: 'c$i',
+        toolName: 'read',
+        content: [TextContent(text: resultText)],
+        isError: false,
+        timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      ),
+    ),
+  ];
+}
+
+ContextLedger _build(List<SessionRecord> history, {LedgerEntryCache? cache}) =>
+    buildContextLedger(
+      visiblePath: history,
+      seqs: RecordSeqIndex(history),
+      cache: cache,
+    );
+
+void main() {
+  // JIT warmup so the timed builds measure the steady state, not the VM.
+  _build(_turns(100));
+
+  test('cold ledger build stays bounded and near-linear at 10k records', () {
+    final small = _turns(1000); // ~334 turns
+    final large = _turns(10000); // ~3334 turns
+
+    final sw1 = Stopwatch()..start();
+    _build(small);
+    final smallMs = sw1.elapsedMilliseconds;
+
+    final sw10 = Stopwatch()..start();
+    _build(large);
+    final largeMs = sw10.elapsedMilliseconds;
+
+    // Sanity ceiling (~7x the measured cost): only a blown-up build — the
+    // quadratic shape this guard exists for — trips it.
+    expect(largeMs, lessThan(3000), reason: '10k-record cold build');
+    // Linear growth is ~10x from 1k to 10k; quadratic is >=100x. The 30x
+    // ratio plus additive slack only trips when growth went superlinear.
+    expect(
+      largeMs,
+      lessThan(smallMs * 30 + 250),
+      reason:
+          'growth 1k->10k must stay near-linear '
+          '(${smallMs}ms -> ${largeMs}ms)',
+    );
+  });
+
+  test('per-pass rebuilds with a shared cache stay incremental', () {
+    final history = _turns(10000);
+    final cache = LedgerEntryCache();
+    _build(history, cache: cache); // cold pass populates the cache
+
+    // Engine shape: every compaction pass rebuilds the ledger over the
+    // whole visible path, with a few new records appended since. 24 passes

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1500
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1500
- **Title**: gh-1499 [PERF] buildContextLedger: memoized per-record entries + O(1) entryAtSeq — ~45x faster per-pass rebuilds, linear cold growth
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1499-context-ledger-index` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +337
- **Deletions**: -60
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T15:56:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T16:09:50Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1499

## Root cause

`buildContextLedger` is O(visible path) per call, and the expensive part of each entry — `estimateTokens`, preview flattening, the `isSyntheticUserText` scan — scales with the record's **content**. Every compaction pass (`_buildView`: judge hide loop, deterministic fallback, LRU re-hide, checkpoint walk) rebuilt the ledger over the whole visible path from scratch, so a marathon session re-processed its entire history on every pass (the profiled 2.0s mean / 58.8s max, 32 calls / 65s total). `RecordSeqIndex.seqOf` was already a map lookup; the real costs were per-record re-derivation plus the linear `entryAtSeq` scan (judge-pick validation, hide token accounting).

## Fix (main's shape preserved, minimal)

- **`LedgerEntryCache`** (ledger.dart): id-keyed memo of the derived entry scalars. The session file is append-only and record ids are stable, so seq/kind/tokens/preview/toolNames never change for a given id; a cache hit rewraps the **current** record instance, and a cached seq that no longer matches the live index recomputes (self-correcting). Ownership: one cache per ledger-rebuilding chain — a `StructuredCompactor` run, or a `CompactExpandController` (cleared when the live `Session` object changes, since ids are unique within a session only). `buildContextLedger`'s new `cache` param is optional — every other caller and test keeps byte-identical behavior.
- **`entryAtSeq`**: map lookup instead of a linear scan.

Ledger output is byte-equivalent — asserted warm-vs-cold entry-by-entry in the new guard, plus all 355 existing `test/compaction/` tests green.

## Description

## Root cause

+List<SessionRecord> _turns(int count, {int startIndex = 0}) => [
+  for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) ..._turn(startIndex + i),

+      parentId: i == 0 ? null : 'r${i - 1}-t',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: UserMessage.text('turn $i: inspect the failing module'),
+    ),

+      parentId: 'r$i-u',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),

+          ToolCall(

+        api: 'anthropic-messages',
+        provider: 'p',
+        model: 'm1',
+        usage: Usage.zero,

+        content: [TextContent(text: resultText)],

+        timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      ),
+    ),

    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1500
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1500
- **Title**: gh-1499 [PERF] buildContextLedger: memoized per-record entries + O(1) entryAtSeq — ~45x faster per-pass rebuilds, linear cold growth
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1499-context-ledger-index` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +337
- **Deletions**: -60
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T15:56:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T16:09:50Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1499

## Root cause

`buildContextLedger` is O(visible path) per call, and the expensive part of each entry — `estimateTokens`, preview flattening, the `isSyntheticUserText` scan — scales with the record's **content**. Every compaction pass (`_buildView`: judge hide loop, deterministic fallback, LRU re-hide, checkpoint walk) rebuilt the ledger over the whole visible path from scratch, so a marathon session re-processed its entire history on every pass (the profiled 2.0s mean / 58.8s max, 32 calls / 65s total). `RecordSeqIndex.seqOf` was already a map lookup; the real costs were per-record re-derivation plus the linear `entryAtSeq` scan (judge-pick validation, hide token accounting).

## Fix (main's shape preserved, minimal)

- **`LedgerEntryCache`** (ledger.dart): id-keyed memo of the derived entry scalars. The session file is append-only and record ids are stable, so seq/kind/tokens/preview/toolNames never change for a given id; a cache hit rewraps the **current** record instance, and a cached seq that no longer matches the live index recomputes (self-correcting). Ownership: one cache per ledger-rebuilding chain — a `StructuredCompactor` run, or a `CompactExpandController` (cleared when the live `Session` object changes, since ids are unique within a session only). `buildContextLedger`'s new `cache` param is optional — every other caller and test keeps byte-identical behavior.
- **`entryAtSeq`**: map lookup instead of a linear scan.

Ledger output is byte-equivalent — asserted warm-vs-cold entry-by-entry in the new guard, plus all 355 existing `test/compaction/` tests green.

## Before / after (standalone dart, synthetic tool-use turns ~1.5 KB result each)

| scenario | before (no memo) | after (memo) |
|---|---|---|
| cold build, 1k records | 54 ms | 54 ms (unchanged path) |
| cold build, 10k records | 424 ms (**×8, linear**) | 424 ms |
| 24 per-pass rebuilds over a 10k-record history | **9,777 ms** | **218 ms (~45×)** |

Issue acceptance: growth is linear (×8 per decade), max < 1s at 10k — and the compaction pattern (pass after pass over grown history) drops from ~10s to ~0.2s. The instrumentation caveat from the issue applies to absolute numbers, not the ratio.

## Regression guard

`test/compaction/structured_ledger_perf_test.dart` (core suite, ~1.5s total, generous CI-jitter bounds): cold-build linearity (30× ratio + 3s sanity ceiling at 10k), bounded incremental-rebuild marathon (24 cached passes < 2.5s — the pre-fix shape runs ~10s), warm-vs-cold byte-equivalence, seq-move self-correction, `clear()`.

## Interplay with PR #1458 (issue #1380 total recall)

Checked `feat/1380-recall`'s full diff before writing this: it reshapes the **obligations** ledger + session-wide search (`lib/src/session/obligations_ledger.dart`, `session_search*.dart`, CLI/prompt wiring) and **does not touch** `lib/src/compaction/structured/{ledger,engine,expand_tool}.dart` — zero file-level conflict expected with this branch. Semantic overlap is nil: #1458's classification consumes `isSyntheticUserText`, which this change calls but never alters; the two "ledgers" are unrelated structures. Merge order is free; whoever lands second rebases on the train as usual (no conflict expected either way). If #1458 lands first and wants the same memo for any future per-turn ledger rebuilds, `LedgerEntryCache` is the seam to reuse.

## Remaining (not in this PR)

- The per-pass `_projectedEntries` walk (`recordTokens`/`hiddenMarkerTokens` per record per pass) and `_refreshState`'s full re-projection are separate per-pass costs outside `buildContextLedger`; the memo does not cover them. Worth a follow-up profile pass.
- Cache memory is bounded by records-ever-visible (~300 bytes/record: ≤110-char preview + scalars) and dies with the run/controller.

| scenario | before (no memo) | after (memo) |
|---|---|---|
| cold build, 1k records | 54 ms | 54 ms (unchanged path) |
| cold build, 10k records | 424 ms (**×8, linear**) | 424 ms |
| 24 per-pass rebuilds over a 10k-record history | **9,777 ms** | **218 ms (~45×)** |

Issue acceptance: growth is linear (×8 per decade), max < 1s at 10k — and the compaction pattern (pass after pass over grown history) drops from ~10s to ~0.2s. The instrumentation caveat from the issue applies to absolute numbers, not the ratio.

+/// One tool-use turn: user ask, assistant tool-call carrier, giant result.
+/// ~1.5 KB of text per turn — realistic file-read sizes, heavy enough that
+/// re-tokenizing history dominates any bookkeeping loop.
+List<SessionRecord> _turns(int count, {int startIndex = 0}) => [
+  for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) ..._turn(startIndex + i),
+];
+
+List<SessionRecord> _turn(int i) {
+  final resultText = 'x.dart:${'line $i content. ' * 44}';
+  return [
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-u',
+      parentId: i == 0 ? null : 'r${i - 1}-t',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: UserMessage.text('turn $i: inspect the failing module'),
+    ),
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-a',
+      parentId: 'r$i-u',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: AssistantMessage(
+        content: [
+          TextContent(text: 'reading the module for turn $i'),
+          ToolCall(
+            id: 'c$i',
+            name: 'read',
+            arguments: {'path': 'lib/mod$i.dart', 'why': 'turn $i'},
+          ),
+        ],
+        api: 'anthropic-messages',
+        provider: 'p',
+        model: 'm1',
+        usage: Usage.zero,
+        stopReason: StopReason.stop,
+        timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      ),
+    ),
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-t',
+      parentId: 'r$i-a',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: ToolResultMessage(
+        toolCallId: 'c$i',
+        toolName: 'read',
+        content: [TextContent(text: resultText)],
+        isError: false,
+        timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      ),
+    ),
+  ];
+}
+
+ContextLedger _build(List<SessionRecord> history, {LedgerEntryCache? cache}) =>
+    buildContextLedger(
+      visiblePath: history,
+      seqs: RecordSeqIndex(history),
+      cache: cache,
+    );

+    final small = _turns(1000); // ~334 turns
+    final large = _turns(10000); // ~3334 turns

+    _build(small);
+    final smallMs = sw1.elapsedMilliseconds;
+
+    final sw10 = Stopwatch()..start();

codex-rs ships a new catalog so the picker / OAuth default stay current

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also
  `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`.
- `dart test` green (integration-tagged excluded from test-core — issue
  #551: `test/integration/**` changes also run the `integration-mock` leg
  per-PR: no-key legs via `MockLlmServer`, `--exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,
  perf,pty`; child-agent-spawn PTY tests carry `pty` and stay in nightly
  (issue #553). Tag-only CI = llm smoke + publish + binaries; nightly keeps
  the full real-provider suite (pty-integration).
  **The Quality gate is deterministic-only (gh-1199): mock LLM everywhere,
  live models never.** Real-provider files carry
  `@Tags(['integration', 'llm'])` and run ONLY in the tag-only
  provider-smoke job and nightly with secrets — the per-PR integration
  shards exclude them at selection (`shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm`) AND
  at invocation (`--exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`), so a model's mood can
  never block a merge. The boundary is self-enforcing:
  `scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` (static-gate step + pinned audit)
  fails any integration-tagged file that looks live without the `llm` tag;
  `test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart` proves the shard
  selection stays live-free. Real-model verification belongs to the bench
  harnesses (terminal-bench / harbor / MLS-Bench) run under supervision,
  plus manual `dart test --tags "integration && llm"` for debugging — NO
  scheduled-or-gate live runs in the PR path. A proven flake (red in ≥2
  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1500
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1500
- **Title**: gh-1499 [PERF] buildContextLedger: memoized per-record entries + O(1) entryAtSeq — ~45x faster per-pass rebuilds, linear cold growth
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1499-context-ledger-index` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +337
- **Deletions**: -60
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T15:56:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T16:09:50Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1499

## Root cause

`buildContextLedger` is O(visible path) per call, and the expensive part of each entry — `estimateTokens`, preview flattening, the `isSyntheticUserText` scan — scales with the record's **content**. Every compaction pass (`_buildView`: judge hide loop, deterministic fallback, LRU re-hide, checkpoint walk) rebuilt the ledger over the whole visible path from scratch, so a marathon session re-processed its entire history on every pass (the profiled 2.0s mean / 58.8s max, 32 calls / 65s total). `RecordSeqIndex.seqOf` was already a map lookup; the real costs were per-record re-derivation plus the linear `entryAtSeq` scan (judge-pick validation, hide token accounting).

## Fix (main's shape preserved, minimal)

- **`LedgerEntryCache`** (ledger.dart): id-keyed memo of the derived entry scalars. The session file is append-only and record ids are stable, so seq/kind/tokens/preview/toolNames never change for a given id; a cache hit rewraps the **current** record instance, and a cached seq that no longer matches the live index recomputes (self-correcting). Ownership: one cache per ledger-rebuilding chain — a `StructuredCompactor` run, or a `CompactExpandController` (cleared when the live `Session` object changes, since ids are unique within a session only). `buildContextLedger`'s new `cache` param is optional — every other caller and test keeps byte-identical behavior.
- **`entryAtSeq`**: map lookup instead of a linear scan.

Ledger output is byte-equivalent — asserted warm-vs-cold entry-by-entry in the new guard, plus all 355 existing `test/compaction/` tests green.

## Before / after (standalone dart, synthetic tool-use turns ~1.5 KB result each)

| scenario | before (no memo) | after (memo) |
|---|---|---|
| cold build, 1k records | 54 ms | 54 ms (unchanged path) |
| cold build, 10k records | 424 ms (**×8, linear**) | 424 ms |
| 24 per-pass rebuilds over a 10k-record history | **9,777 ms** | **218 ms (~45×)** |

Issue acceptance: growth is linear (×8 per decade), max < 1s at 10k — and the compaction pattern (pass after pass over grown history) drops from ~10s to ~0.2s. The instrumentation caveat from the issue applies to absolute numbers, not the ratio.

## Regression guard

`test/compaction/structured_ledger_perf_test.dart` (core suite, ~1.5s total, generous CI-jitter bounds): cold-build linearity (30× ratio + 3s sanity ceiling at 10k), bounded incremental-rebuild marathon (24 cached passes < 2.5s — the pre-fix shape runs ~10s), warm-vs-cold byte-equivalence, seq-move self-correction, `clear()`.

## Interplay with PR #1458 (issue #1380 total recall)

Checked `feat/1380-recall`'s full diff before writing this: it reshapes the **obligations** ledger + session-wide search (`lib/src/session/obligations_ledger.dart`, `session_search*.dart`, CLI/prompt wiring) and **does not touch** `lib/src/compaction/structured/{ledger,engine,expand_tool}.dart` — zero file-level conflict expected with this branch. Semantic overlap is nil: #1458's classification consumes `isSyntheticUserText`, which this change calls but never alters; the two "ledgers" are unrelated structures. Merge order is free; whoever lands second rebases on the train as usual (no conflict expected either way). If #1458 lands first and wants the same memo for any future per-turn ledger rebuilds, `LedgerEntryCache` is the seam to reuse.

## Remaining (not in this PR)

- The per-pass `_projectedEntries` walk (`recordTokens`/`hiddenMarkerTokens` per record per pass) and `_refreshState`'s full re-projection are separate per-pass costs outside `buildContextLedger`; the memo does not cover them. Worth a follow-up profile pass.
- Cache memory is bounded by records-ever-visible (~300 bytes/record: ≤110-char preview + scalars) and dies with the run/controller.

+/// Regression guard with GENEROUS bounds (CI runners jitter): the absolute
+/// ceilings are 10-30x the measured local costs, tight enough that the

+import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/flutter_agent_harness.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/src/compaction/structured/ledger.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/src/compaction/structured/projection.dart';

+/// One tool-use turn: user ask, assistant tool-call carrier, giant result.
+/// ~1.5 KB of text per turn — realistic file-read sizes, heavy enough that
+/// re-tokenizing history dominates any bookkeeping loop.
+List<SessionRecord> _turns(int count, {int startIndex = 0}) => [
+  for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) ..._turn(startIndex + i),
+];
+
+List<SessionRecord> _turn(int i) {
+  final resultText = 'x.dart:${'line $i content. ' * 44}';
+  return [
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-u',

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1500
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1500
- **Title**: gh-1499 [PERF] buildContextLedger: memoized per-record entries + O(1) entryAtSeq — ~45x faster per-pass rebuilds, linear cold growth
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1499-context-ledger-index` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +337
- **Deletions**: -60
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T15:56:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T16:09:50Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1499

## Root cause

`buildContextLedger` is O(visible path) per call, and the expensive part of each entry — `estimateTokens`, preview flattening, the `isSyntheticUserText` scan — scales with the record's **content**. Every compaction pass (`_buildView`: judge hide loop, deterministic fallback, LRU re-hide, checkpoint walk) rebuilt the ledger over the whole visible path from scratch, so a marathon session re-processed its entire history on every pass (the profiled 2.0s mean / 58.8s max, 32 calls / 65s total). `RecordSeqIndex.seqOf` was already a map lookup; the real costs were per-record re-derivation plus the linear `entryAtSeq` scan (judge-pick validation, hide token accounting).

## Fix (main's shape preserved, minimal)

- **`LedgerEntryCache`** (ledger.dart): id-keyed memo of the derived entry scalars. The session file is append-only and record ids are stable, so seq/kind/tokens/preview/toolNames never change for a given id; a cache hit rewraps the **current** record instance, and a cached seq that no longer matches the live index recomputes (self-correcting). Ownership: one cache per ledger-rebuilding chain — a `StructuredCompactor` run, or a `CompactExpandController` (cleared when the live `Session` object changes, since ids are unique within a session only). `buildContextLedger`'s new `cache` param is optional — every other caller and test keeps byte-identical behavior.
- **`entryAtSeq`**: map lookup instead of a linear scan.

Ledger output is byte-equivalent — asserted warm-vs-cold entry-by-entry in the new guard, plus all 355 existing `test/compaction/` tests green.

## Before / after (standalone dart, synthetic tool-use turns ~1.5 KB result each)

| scenario | before (no memo) | after (memo) |
|---|---|---|
| cold build, 1k records | 54 ms | 54 ms (unchanged path) |
| cold build, 10k records | 424 ms (**×8, linear**) | 424 ms |
| 24 per-pass rebuilds over a 10k-record history | **9,777 ms** | **218 ms (~45×)** |

Issue acceptance: growth is linear (×8 per decade), max < 1s at 10k — and the compaction pattern (pass after pass over grown history) drops from ~10s to ~0.2s. The instrumentation caveat from the issue applies to absolute numbers, not the ratio.

## Regression guard

`test/compaction/structured_ledger_perf_test.dart` (core suite, ~1.5s total, generous CI-jitter bounds): cold-build linearity (30× ratio + 3s sanity ceiling at 10k), bounded incremental-rebuild marathon (24 cached passes < 2.5s — the pre-fix shape runs ~10s), warm-vs-cold byte-equivalence, seq-move self-correction, `clear()`.

## Interplay with PR #1458 (issue #1380 total recall)

Checked `feat/1380-recall`'s full diff before writing this: it reshapes the **obligations** ledger + session-wide search (`lib/src/session/obligations_ledger.dart`, `session_search*.dart`, CLI/prompt wiring) and **does not touch** `lib/src/compaction/structured/{ledger,engine,expand_tool}.dart` — zero file-level conflict expected with this branch. Semantic overlap is nil: #1458's classification consumes `isSyntheticUserText`, which this change calls but never alters; the two "ledgers" are unrelated structures. Merge order is free; whoever lands second rebases on the train as usual (no conflict expected either way). If #1458 lands first and wants the same memo for any future per-turn ledger rebuilds, `LedgerEntryCache` is the seam to reuse.

## Remaining (not in this PR)

- The per-pass `_projectedEntries` walk (`recordTokens`/`hiddenMarkerTokens` per record per pass) and `_refreshState`'s full re-projection are separate per-pass costs outside `buildContextLedger`; the memo does not cover them. Worth a follow-up profile pass.
- Cache memory is bounded by records-ever-visible (~300 bytes/record: ≤110-char preview + scalars) and dies with the run/controller.

+/// Issue #1499 — the ledger build's growth shape and rebuild cost.
+///
+/// Regression guard with GENEROUS bounds (CI runners jitter): the absolute
+/// ceilings are 10-30x the measured local costs, tight enough that the
+/// historical shape — every compaction pass re-tokenizing the whole visible
+/// history from scratch, plus linear `entryAtSeq` scans — fails them on a
+/// synthetic 10k-record session.
+library;
+
+import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/flutter_agent_harness.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/src/compaction/structured/ledger.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/src/compaction/structured/projection.dart';
+import 'package:test/test.dart';
+
+/// One tool-use turn: user ask, assistant tool-call carrier, giant result.
+/// ~1.5 KB of text per turn — realistic file-read sizes, heavy enough that
+/// re-tokenizing history dominates any bookkeeping loop.
+List<SessionRecord> _turns(int count, {int startIndex = 0}) => [
+  for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) ..._turn(startIndex + i),
+];
+
+List<SessionRecord> _turn(int i) {
+  final resultText = 'x.dart:${'line $i content. ' * 44}';
+  return [
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-u',
+      parentId: i == 0 ? null : 'r${i - 1}-t',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: UserMessage.text('turn $i: inspect the failing module'),
+    ),
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-a',
+      parentId: 'r$i-u',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: AssistantMessage(
+        content: [
+          TextContent(text: 'reading the module for turn $i'),
+          ToolCall(
+            id: 'c$i',
+            name: 'read',
+            arguments: {'path': 'lib/mod$i.dart', 'why': 'turn $i'},
+          ),
+        ],
+        api: 'anthropic-messages',
+        provider: 'p',
+        model: 'm1',
+        usage: Usage.zero,
+        stopReason: StopReason.stop,
+        timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      ),
+    ),
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-t',
+      parentId: 'r$i-a',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: ToolResultMessage(
+        toolCallId: 'c$i',
+        toolName: 'read',
+        content: [TextContent(text: resultText)],
+        isError: false,
+        timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      ),
+    ),
+  ];
+}
+
+ContextLedger _build(List<SessionRecord> history, {LedgerEntryCache? cache}) =>
+    buildContextLedger(
+      visiblePath: history,
+      seqs: RecordSeqIndex(history),
+      cache: cache,
+    );
+
+void main() {
+  // JIT warmup so the timed builds measure the steady state, not the VM.
+  _build(_turns(100));
+
+  test('cold ledger build stays bounded and near-linear at 10k records', () {
+    final small = _turns(1000); // ~334 turns
+    final large = _turns(10000); // ~3334 turns
+
+    final sw1 = Stopwatch()..start();
+    _build(small);
+    final smallMs = sw1.elapsedMilliseconds;
+
+    final sw10 = Stopwatch()..start();
+    _build(large);
+    final largeMs = sw10.elapsedMilliseconds;
+
+    // Sanity ceiling (~7x the measured cost): only a blown-up build — the
+    // quadratic shape this guard exists for — trips it.
+    expect(largeMs, lessThan(3000), reason: '10k-record cold build');
+    // Linear growth is ~10x from 1k to 10k; quadratic is >=100x. The 30x
+    // ratio plus additive slack only trips when growth went superlinear.
+    expect(
+      largeMs,
+      lessThan(smallMs * 30 + 250),
+      reason:
+          'growth 1k->10k must stay near-linear '
+          '(${smallMs}ms -> ${largeMs}ms)',
+    );
+  });
+
+  test('per-pass rebuilds with a shared cache stay incremental', () {
+    final history = _turns(10000);
+    final cache = LedgerEntryCache();
+    _build(history, cache: cache); // cold pass populates the cache
+

1. `LedgerEntryCache` — memo keyed by record id. Self-correcting seq guard. But wait — is seq the only thing that could change for an id? The PR says the session file is append-only and record ids are stable, so seq/kind/tokens/preview/toolNames never change. But what if a record's **content changes** in place while keeping the same id and seq? E.g., message record edits? Let me check whether SessionRecord can be mutated — e.g., ToolResultMessage content updated, or MessageRecord with same id being replaced. The `record` instance itself is rewrapped on cache hit, but `kind/tokens/preview/toolNames` are scalars derived from content. If content mutates without seq changing, the cached scalars would be stale. Is there any in-place mutation of records in the codebase? Worth grepping.

2. The `_entryFor` caches non-null entries. Note: records that don't project (default -> null) are not cached, so they get re-scanned each pass — fine, they're cheap.

3. `_messageEntry` — is it cached too? In the diff, cache-hit path rewraps LedgerEntry._ with cached scalars, including for message records (kind from cache). Note the cache stores preview which is ≤110 chars, toolNames, tokens. OK.

4. Memory: cache grows unbounded per run — acknowledged in PR description.

5. `ContextLedger._entryBySeq` map — duplicate seqs? seqs come from RecordSeqIndex built over the whole session entries — presumably unique. If two entries had same seq, last wins vs old behavior first-wins. Minor.

6. In engine.dart — `StructuredCompactor` — one compaction run per session? The compactor instance could be reused across sessions? The docstring says one cache per compactor run. If the StructuredCompactor instance is reused across sessions (e.g., the host creates one compactor per agent rather than per run), the cache would be keyed on stale ids of the previous session. Would that cause a correctness bug? Cache hit requires cached.seq == live seqOf(record.id). If a new session happens to have a record with the same id and same seq as a cached entry from a previous session, the cached scalars would be reused — potentially wrong tokens/preview if content differs. Are record ids globally unique (uuid) or sequential ("r1", "r2")? If uuid-based, collision probability negligible. Let me check how record ids are generated.

Also: within a single session, could a record's content change while id and seq stay the same? E.g., compaction replaces records? No — compaction hides records, doesn't mutate. But checkpoint records? Or branch summaries appended later? Those have new ids. What about `Session` implementations that reload records from disk — same ids, same content, new instances. Fine.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1500
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1500
- **Title**: gh-1499 [PERF] buildContextLedger: memoized per-record entries + O(1) entryAtSeq — ~45x faster per-pass rebuilds, linear cold growth
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1499-context-ledger-index` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +337
- **Deletions**: -60
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T15:56:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T16:09:50Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1499

## Root cause

`buildContextLedger` is O(visible path) per call, and the expensive part of each entry — `estimateTokens`, preview flattening, the `isSyntheticUserText` scan — scales with the record's **content**. Every compaction pass (`_buildView`: judge hide loop, deterministic fallback, LRU re-hide, checkpoint walk) rebuilt the ledger over the whole visible path from scratch, so a marathon session re-processed its entire history on every pass (the profiled 2.0s mean / 58.8s max, 32 calls / 65s total). `RecordSeqIndex.seqOf` was already a map lookup; the real costs were per-record re-derivation plus the linear `entryAtSeq` scan (judge-pick validation, hide token accounting).

## Fix (main's shape preserved, minimal)

- **`LedgerEntryCache`** (ledger.dart): id-keyed memo of the derived entry scalars. The session file is append-only and record ids are stable, so seq/kind/tokens/preview/toolNames never change for a given id; a cache hit rewraps the **current** record instance, and a cached seq that no longer matches the live index recomputes (self-correcting). Ownership: one cache per ledger-rebuilding chain — a `StructuredCompactor` run, or a `CompactExpandController` (cleared when the live `Session` object changes, since ids are unique within a session only). `buildContextLedger`'s new `cache` param is optional — every other caller and test keeps byte-identical behavior.
- **`entryAtSeq`**: map lookup instead of a linear scan.

Ledger output is byte-equivalent — asserted warm-vs-cold entry-by-entry in the new guard, plus all 355 existing `test/compaction/` tests green.

## Before / after (standalone dart, synthetic tool-use turns ~1.5 KB result each)

| scenario | before (no memo) | after (memo) |
|---|---|---|
| cold build, 1k records | 54 ms | 54 ms (unchanged path) |
| cold build, 10k records | 424 ms (**×8, linear**) | 424 ms |
| 24 per-pass rebuilds over a 10k-record history | **9,777 ms** | **218 ms (~45×)** |

Issue acceptance: growth is linear (×8 per decade), max < 1s at 10k — and the compaction pattern (pass after pass over grown history) drops from ~10s to ~0.2s. The instrumentation caveat from the issue applies to absolute numbers, not the ratio.

## Regression guard

`test/compaction/structured_ledger_perf_test.dart` (core suite, ~1.5s total, generous CI-jitter bounds): cold-build linearity (30× ratio + 3s sanity ceiling at 10k), bounded incremental-rebuild marathon (24 cached passes < 2.5s — the pre-fix shape runs ~10s), warm-vs-cold byte-equivalence, seq-move self-correction, `clear()`.

## Interplay with PR #1458 (issue #1380 total recall)

Checked `feat/1380-recall`'s full diff before writing this: it reshapes the **obligations** ledger + session-wide search (`lib/src/session/obligations_ledger.dart`, `session_search*.dart`, CLI/prompt wiring) and **does not touch** `lib/src/compaction/structured/{ledger,engine,expand_tool}.dart` — zero file-level conflict expected with this branch. Semantic overlap is nil: #1458's classification consumes `isSyntheticUserText`, which this change calls but never alters; the two "ledgers" are unrelated structures. Merge order is free; whoever lands second rebases on the train as usual (no conflict expected either way). If #1458 lands first and wants the same memo for any future per-turn ledger rebuilds, `LedgerEntryCache` is the seam to reuse.

## Remaining (not in this PR)

- The per-pass `_projectedEntries` walk (`recordTokens`/`hiddenMarkerTokens` per record per pass) and `_refreshState`'s full re-projection are separate per-pass costs outside `buildContextLedger`; the memo does not cover them. Worth a follow-up profile pass.
- Cache memory is bounded by records-ever-visible (~300 bytes/record: ≤110-char preview + scalars) and dies with the run/controller.

+  for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) ..._turn(startIndex + i),

+  return [

+      parentId: i == 0 ? null : 'r${i - 1}-t',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: UserMessage.text('turn $i: inspect the failing module'),
+    ),

+      id: 'r$i-a',
+      parentId: 'r$i-u',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),

+        api: 'anthropic-messages',
+        provider: 'p',
+        model: 'm1',
+        usage: Usage.zero,

+      parentId: 'r$i-a',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),

+        toolName: 'read',

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:

    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open

    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since

logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1500
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1500
- **Title**: gh-1499 [PERF] buildContextLedger: memoized per-record entries + O(1) entryAtSeq — ~45x faster per-pass rebuilds, linear cold growth
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1499-context-ledger-index` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +337
- **Deletions**: -60
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T15:56:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T16:09:50Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1499

## Root cause

`buildContextLedger` is O(visible path) per call, and the expensive part of each entry — `estimateTokens`, preview flattening, the `isSyntheticUserText` scan — scales with the record's **content**. Every compaction pass (`_buildView`: judge hide loop, deterministic fallback, LRU re-hide, checkpoint walk) rebuilt the ledger over the whole visible path from scratch, so a marathon session re-processed its entire history on every pass (the profiled 2.0s mean / 58.8s max, 32 calls / 65s total). `RecordSeqIndex.seqOf` was already a map lookup; the real costs were per-record re-derivation plus the linear `entryAtSeq` scan (judge-pick validation, hide token accounting).

## Fix (main's shape preserved, minimal)

- **`LedgerEntryCache`** (ledger.dart): id-keyed memo of the derived entry scalars. The session file is append-only and record ids are stable, so seq/kind/tokens/preview/toolNames never change for a given id; a cache hit rewraps the **current** record instance, and a cached seq that no longer matches the live index recomputes (self-correcting). Ownership: one cache per ledger-rebuilding chain — a `StructuredCompactor` run, or a `CompactExpandController` (cleared when the live `Session` object changes, since ids are unique within a session only). `buildContextLedger`'s new `cache` param is optional — every other caller and test keeps byte-identical behavior.
- **`entryAtSeq`**: map lookup instead of a linear scan.

Ledger output is byte-equivalent — asserted warm-vs-cold entry-by-entry in the new guard, plus all 355 existing `test/compaction/` tests green.

## Before / after (standalone dart, synthetic tool-use turns ~1.5 KB result each)

| scenario | before (no memo) | after (memo) |
|---|---|---|
| cold build, 1k records | 54 ms | 54 ms (unchanged path) |
| cold build, 10k records | 424 ms (**×8, linear**) | 424 ms |
| 24 per-pass rebuilds over a 10k-record history | **9,777 ms** | **218 ms (~45×)** |

Issue acceptance: growth is linear (×8 per decade), max < 1s at 10k — and the compaction pattern (pass after pass over grown history) drops from ~10s to ~0.2s. The instrumentation caveat from the issue applies to absolute numbers, not the ratio.

## Regression guard

`test/compaction/structured_ledger_perf_test.dart` (core suite, ~1.5s total, generous CI-jitter bounds): cold-build linearity (30× ratio + 3s sanity ceiling at 10k), bounded incremental-rebuild marathon (24 cached passes < 2.5s — the pre-fix shape runs ~10s), warm-vs-cold byte-equivalence, seq-move self-correction, `clear()`.

## Interplay with PR #1458 (issue #1380 total recall)

Checked `feat/1380-recall`'s full diff before writing this: it reshapes the **obligations** ledger + session-wide search (`lib/src/session/obligations_ledger.dart`, `session_search*.dart`, CLI/prompt wiring) and **does not touch** `lib/src/compaction/structured/{ledger,engine,expand_tool}.dart` — zero file-level conflict expected with this branch. Semantic overlap is nil: #1458's classification consumes `isSyntheticUserText`, which this change calls but never alters; the two "ledgers" are unrelated structures. Merge order is free; whoever lands second rebases on the train as usual (no conflict expected either way). If #1458 lands first and wants the same memo for any future per-turn ledger rebuilds, `LedgerEntryCache` is the seam to reuse.

## Remaining (not in this PR)

- The per-pass `_projectedEntries` walk (`recordTokens`/`hiddenMarkerTokens` per record per pass) and `_refreshState`'s full re-projection are separate per-pass costs outside `buildContextLedger`; the memo does not cover them. Worth a follow-up profile pass.
- Cache memory is bounded by records-ever-visible (~300 bytes/record: ≤110-char preview + scalars) and dies with the run/controller.

+/// Issue #1499 — the ledger build's growth shape and rebuild cost.
+///
+/// Regression guard with GENEROUS bounds (CI runners jitter): the absolute
+/// ceilings are 10-30x the measured local costs, tight enough that the
+/// historical shape — every compaction pass re-tokenizing the whole visible
+/// history from scratch, plus linear `entryAtSeq` scans — fails them on a
+/// synthetic 10k-record session.
+library;
+
+import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/flutter_agent_harness.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/src/compaction/structured/ledger.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/src/compaction/structured/projection.dart';
+import 'package:test/test.dart';
+
+/// One tool-use turn: user ask, assistant tool-call carrier, giant result.
+/// ~1.5 KB of text per turn — realistic file-read sizes, heavy enough that
+/// re-tokenizing history dominates any bookkeeping loop.
+List<SessionRecord> _turns(int count, {int startIndex = 0}) => [
+  for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) ..._turn(startIndex + i),
+];
+
+List<SessionRecord> _turn(int i) {
+  final resultText = 'x.dart:${'line $i content. ' * 44}';
+  return [
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-u',
+      parentId: i == 0 ? null : 'r${i - 1}-t',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: UserMessage.text('turn $i: inspect the failing module'),
+    ),
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-a',
+      parentId: 'r$i-u',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: AssistantMessage(
+        content: [
+          TextContent(text: 'reading the module for turn $i'),
+          ToolCall(
+            id: 'c$i',
+            name: 'read',
+            arguments: {'path': 'lib/mod$i.dart', 'why': 'turn $i'},
+          ),
+        ],
+        api: 'anthropic-messages',
+        provider: 'p',
+        model: 'm1',
+        usage: Usage.zero,
+        stopReason: StopReason.stop,
+        timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      ),
+    ),
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-t',
+      parentId: 'r$i-a',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: ToolResultMessage(
+        toolCallId: 'c$i',
+        toolName: 'read',
+        content: [TextContent(text: resultText)],
+        isError: false,
+        timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      ),
+    ),
+  ];
+}
+
+ContextLedger _build(List<SessionRecord> history, {LedgerEntryCache? cache}) =>
+    buildContextLedger(
+      visiblePath: history,
+      seqs: RecordSeqIndex(history),
+      cache: cache,
+    );
+
+void main() {
+  // JIT warmup so the timed builds measure the steady state, not the VM.
+  _build(_turns(100));
+
+  test('cold ledger build stays bounded and near-linear at 10k records', () {
+    final small = _turns(1000); // ~334 turns
+    final large = _turns(10000); // ~3334 turns
+
+    final sw1 = Stopwatch()..start();
+    _build(small);
+    final smallMs = sw1.elapsedMilliseconds;
+
+    final sw10 = Stopwatch()..start();
+    _build(large);
+    final largeMs = sw10.elapsedMilliseconds;
+
+    // Sanity ceiling (~7x the measured cost): only a blown-up build — the
+    // quadratic shape this guard exists for — trips it.
+    expect(largeMs, lessThan(3000), reason: '10k-record cold build');
+    // Linear growth is ~10x from 1k to 10k; quadratic is >=100x. The 30x
+    // ratio plus additive slack only trips when growth went superlinear.
+    expect(
+      largeMs,
+      lessThan(smallMs * 30 + 250),
+      reason:
+          'growth 1k->10k must stay near-linear '
+          '(${smallMs}ms -> ${largeMs}ms)',
+    );
+  });
+
+  test('per-pass rebuilds with a shared cache stay incremental', () {
+    final history = _turns(10000);
+    final cache = LedgerEntryCache();
+    _build(history, cache: cache); // cold pass populates the cache
+
+    // Engine shape: every compaction pass rebuilds the ledger over the
+    // whole visible path, with a few new records appended since. 24 passes

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1500
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1500
- **Title**: gh-1499 [PERF] buildContextLedger: memoized per-record entries + O(1) entryAtSeq — ~45x faster per-pass rebuilds, linear cold growth
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1499-context-ledger-index` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +337
- **Deletions**: -60
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T15:56:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T16:09:50Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1499

## Root cause

`buildContextLedger` is O(visible path) per call, and the expensive part of each entry — `estimateTokens`, preview flattening, the `isSyntheticUserText` scan — scales with the record's **content**. Every compaction pass (`_buildView`: judge hide loop, deterministic fallback, LRU re-hide, checkpoint walk) rebuilt the ledger over the whole visible path from scratch, so a marathon session re-processed its entire history on every pass (the profiled 2.0s mean / 58.8s max, 32 calls / 65s total). `RecordSeqIndex.seqOf` was already a map lookup; the real costs were per-record re-derivation plus the linear `entryAtSeq` scan (judge-pick validation, hide token accounting).

## Fix (main's shape preserved, minimal)

- **`LedgerEntryCache`** (ledger.dart): id-keyed memo of the derived entry scalars. The session file is append-only and record ids are stable, so seq/kind/tokens/preview/toolNames never change for a given id; a cache hit rewraps the **current** record instance, and a cached seq that no longer matches the live index recomputes (self-correcting). Ownership: one cache per ledger-rebuilding chain — a `StructuredCompactor` run, or a `CompactExpandController` (cleared when the live `Session` object changes, since ids are unique within a session only). `buildContextLedger`'s new `cache` param is optional — every other caller and test keeps byte-identical behavior.
- **`entryAtSeq`**: map lookup instead of a linear scan.

Ledger output is byte-equivalent — asserted warm-vs-cold entry-by-entry in the new guard, plus all 355 existing `test/compaction/` tests green.

## Before / after (standalone dart, synthetic tool-use turns ~1.5 KB result each)

| scenario | before (no memo) | after (memo) |
|---|---|---|
| cold build, 1k records | 54 ms | 54 ms (unchanged path) |
| cold build, 10k records | 424 ms (**×8, linear**) | 424 ms |
| 24 per-pass rebuilds over a 10k-record history | **9,777 ms** | **218 ms (~45×)** |

## Regression guard

# pr-1500: gh-1499 [PERF] buildContextLedger: memoized per-record entries + O(1) entryAtSeq — ~45x faster per-pass rebuilds, linear cold growth

## Description

Fixes #1499

## Root cause

`buildContextLedger` is O(visible path) per call, and the expensive part of each entry — `estimateTokens`, preview flattening, the `isSyntheticUserText` scan — scales with the record's **content**. Every compaction pass (`_buildView`: judge hide loop, deterministic fallback, LRU re-hide, checkpoint walk) rebuilt the ledger over the whole visible path from scratch, so a marathon session re-processed its entire history on every pass (the profiled 2.0s mean / 58.8s max, 32 calls / 65s total). `RecordSeqIndex.seqOf` was already a map lookup; the real costs were per-record re-derivation plus the linear `entryAtSeq` scan (judge-pick validation, hide token accounting).

## Fix (main's shape preserved, minimal)

- **`LedgerEntryCache`** (ledger.dart): id-keyed memo of the derived entry scalars. +/// One tool-use turn: user ask, assistant tool-call carrier, giant result.
+/// ~1.5 KB of text per turn — realistic file-read sizes, heavy enough that
+/// re-tokenizing history dominates any bookkeeping loop.
+List<SessionRecord> _turns(int count, {int startIndex = 0}) => [
+  for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) ..._turn(startIndex + i),
+];

+List<SessionRecord> _turn(int i) {
+  final resultText = 'x.dart:${'line $i content. ' * 44}';
+  return [
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-u',
+      parentId: i == 0 ? null : 'r${i - 1}-t',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: UserMessage.text('turn $i: inspect the failing module'),
+    ),
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-a',
+      parentId: 'r$i-u',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: AssistantMessage(
+        content: [
+          TextContent(text: 'reading the module for turn $i'),
+          ToolCall(
+            id: 'c$i',
+            name: 'read',
+            arguments: {'path': 'lib/mod$i.dart', 'why': 'turn $i'},
+          ),
+        ],
+        api: 'anthropic-messages',
+        provider: 'p',
+        model: 'm1',
+        usage: Usage.zero,
+        stopReason: StopReason.stop,
+        timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      ),
+    ),
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-t',
+      parentId: 'r$i-a',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: ToolResultMessage(
+        toolCallId: 'c$i',
+        toolName: 'read',
+        content: [TextContent(text: resultText)],
+        isError: false,
+        timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      ),
+    ),
+  ];
+}

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also
  `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`.
- `dart test` green (integration-tagged excluded from test-core — issue
  #551: `test/integration/**` changes also run the `integration-mock` leg
  per-PR: no-key legs via `MockLlmServer`, `--exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,
  perf,pty`; child-agent-spawn PTY tests carry `pty` and stay in nightly
  (issue #553). Tag-only CI = llm smoke + publish + binaries; nightly keeps
  the full real-provider suite (pty-integration).
  **The Quality gate is deterministic-only (gh-1199): mock LLM everywhere,
  live models never.** Real-provider files carry
  `@Tags(['integration', 'llm'])` and run ONLY in the tag-only
  provider-smoke job and nightly with secrets — the per-PR integration
  shards exclude them at selection (`shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm`) AND
  at invocation (`--exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`), so a model's mood can

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1500
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1500
- **Title**: gh-1499 [PERF] buildContextLedger: memoized per-record entries + O(1) entryAtSeq — ~45x faster per-pass rebuilds, linear cold growth
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1499-context-ledger-index` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +337
- **Deletions**: -60
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T15:56:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T16:09:50Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1499

## Root cause

`buildContextLedger` is O(visible path) per call, and the expensive part of each entry — `estimateTokens`, preview flattening, the `isSyntheticUserText` scan — scales with the record's **content**. Every compaction pass (`_buildView`: judge hide loop, deterministic fallback, LRU re-hide, checkpoint walk) rebuilt the ledger over the whole visible path from scratch, so a marathon session re-processed its entire history on every pass (the profiled 2.0s mean / 58.8s max, 32 calls / 65s total). `RecordSeqIndex.seqOf` was already a map lookup; the real costs were per-record re-derivation plus the linear `entryAtSeq` scan (judge-pick validation, hide token accounting).

## Fix (main's shape preserved, minimal)

- **`LedgerEntryCache`** (ledger.dart): id-keyed memo of the derived entry scalars. The session file is append-only and record ids are stable, so seq/kind/tokens/preview/toolNames never change for a given id; a cache hit rewraps the **current** record instance, and a cached seq that no longer matches the live index recomputes (self-correcting). Ownership: one cache per ledger-rebuilding chain — a `StructuredCompactor` run, or a `CompactExpandController` (cleared when the live `Session` object changes, since ids are unique within a session only). `buildContextLedger`'s new `cache` param is optional — every other caller and test keeps byte-identical behavior.
- **`entryAtSeq`**: map lookup instead of a linear scan.

Ledger output is byte-equivalent — asserted warm-vs-cold entry-by-entry in the new guard, plus all 355 existing `test/compaction/` tests green.

## Before / after (standalone dart, synthetic tool-use turns ~1.5 KB result each)

| scenario | before (no memo) | after (memo) |
|---|---|---|
| cold build, 1k records | 54 ms | 54 ms (unchanged path) |
| cold build, 10k records | 424 ms (**×8, linear**) | 424 ms |
| 24 per-pass rebuilds over a 10k-record history | **9,777 ms** | **218 ms (~45×)** |

Issue acceptance: growth is linear (×8 per decade), max < 1s at 10k — and the compaction pattern (pass after pass over grown history) drops from ~10s to ~0.2s. The instrumentation caveat from the issue applies to absolute numbers, not the ratio.

## Regression guard

`test/compaction/structured_ledger_perf_test.dart` (core suite, ~1.5s total, generous CI-jitter bounds): cold-build linearity (30× ratio + 3s sanity ceiling at 10k), bounded incremental-rebuild marathon (24 cached passes < 2.5s — the pre-fix shape runs ~10s), warm-vs-cold byte-equivalence, seq-move self-correction, `clear()`.

## Interplay with PR #1458 (issue #1380 total recall)

Checked `feat/1380-recall`'s full diff before writing this: it reshapes the **obligations** ledger + session-wide search (`lib/src/session/obligations_ledger.dart`, `session_search*.dart`, CLI/prompt wiring) and **does not touch** `lib/src/compaction/structured/{ledger,engine,expand_tool}.dart` — zero file-level conflict expected with this branch. Semantic overlap is nil: #1458's classification consumes `isSyntheticUserText`, which this change calls but never alters; the two "ledgers" are unrelated structures. Merge order is free; whoever lands second rebases on the train as usual (no conflict expected either way). If #1458 lands first and wants the same memo for any future per-turn ledger rebuilds, `LedgerEntryCache` is the seam to reuse.

## Remaining (not in this PR)

- The per-pass `_projectedEntries` walk (`recordTokens`/`hiddenMarkerTokens` per record per pass) and `_refreshState`'s full re-projection are separate per-pass costs outside `buildContextLedger`; the memo does not cover them. Worth a follow-up profile pass.
- Cache memory is bounded by records-ever-visible (~300 bytes/record: ≤110-char preview + scalars) and dies with the run/controller.

+/// Issue #1499 — the ledger build's growth shape and rebuild cost.
+///
+/// Regression guard with GENEROUS bounds (CI runners jitter): the absolute
+/// ceilings are 10-30x the measured local costs, tight enough that the
+/// historical shape — every compaction pass re-tokenizing the whole visible

+library;
+
+import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/flutter_agent_harness.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/src/compaction/structured/ledger.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_agent_harness/src/compaction/structured/projection.dart';
+import 'package:test/test.dart';
+
+/// One tool-use turn: user ask, assistant tool-call carrier, giant result.
+/// ~1.5 KB of text per turn — realistic file-read sizes, heavy enough that
+/// re-tokenizing history dominates any bookkeeping loop.
+List<SessionRecord> _turns(int count, {int startIndex = 0}) => [
+  for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) ..._turn(startIndex + i),
+];
+
+List<SessionRecord> _turn(int i) {
+  final resultText = 'x.dart:${'line $i content. ' * 44}';
+  return [
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-u',
+      parentId: i == 0 ? null : 'r${i - 1}-t',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: UserMessage.text('turn $i: inspect the failing module'),
+    ),
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-a',
+      parentId: 'r$i-u',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: AssistantMessage(
+        content: [
+          TextContent(text: 'reading the module for turn $i'),
+          ToolCall(
+            id: 'c$i',
+            name: 'read',
+            arguments: {'path': 'lib/mod$i.dart', 'why': 'turn $i'},
+          ),
+        ],
+        api: 'anthropic-messages',
+        provider: 'p',
+        model: 'm1',
+        usage: Usage.zero,
+        stopReason: StopReason.stop,
+        timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      ),
+    ),
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-t',
+      parentId: 'r$i-a',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: ToolResultMessage(
+        toolCallId: 'c$i',
+        toolName: 'read',
+        content: [TextContent(text: resultText)],
+        isError: false,
+        timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      ),
+    ),
+  ];
+}
+
+ContextLedger _build(List<SessionRecord> history, {LedgerEntryCache? cache}) =>

# pr-1500: gh-1499 [PERF] buildContextLedger: memoized per-record entries + O(1) entryAtSeq — ~45x faster per-pass rebuilds, linear cold growth

## Description

Fixes #1499

## Root cause

`buildContextLedger` is O(visible path) per call, and the expensive part of each entry — `estimateTokens`, preview flattening, the `isSyntheticUserText` scan — scales with the record's **content**. Every compaction pass (`_buildView`: judge hide loop, deterministic fallback, LRU re-hide, checkpoint walk) rebuilt the ledger over the whole visible path from scratch, so a marathon session re-processed its entire history on every pass (the profiled 2.0s mean / 58.8s max, 32 calls / 65s total). `RecordSeqIndex.seqOf` was already a map lookup; the real costs were per-record re-derivation plus the linear `entryAtSeq` scan (judge-pick validation, hide token accounting).

## Fix (main's shape preserved, minimal)

- **`LedgerEntryCache`** (ledger.dart): id-keyed memo of the derived entry scalars. The session file is append-only and record ids are stable, so seq/kind/tokens/preview/toolNames never change for a given id; a cache hit rewraps the **current** record instance, and a cached seq that no longer matches the live index recomputes (self-correcting). Ownership: one cache per ledger-rebuilding chain — a `StructuredCompactor` run, or a `CompactExpandController` (cleared when the live `Session` object changes, since ids are unique within a session only). `buildContextLedger`'s new `cache` param is optional — every other caller and test keeps byte-identical behavior.
- **`entryAtSeq`**: map lookup instead of a linear scan.

Ledger output is byte-equivalent — asserted warm-vs-cold entry-by-entry in the new guard, plus all 355 existing `test/compaction/` tests green.

## Before / after (standalone dart, synthetic tool-use turns ~1.5 KB result each)

| scenario | before (no memo) | after (memo) |
|---|---|---|
| cold build, 1k records | 54 ms | 54 ms (unchanged path) |
| cold build, 10k records | 424 ms (**×8, linear**) | 424 ms |
| 24 per-pass rebuilds over a 10k-record history | **9,777 ms** | **218 ms (~45×)** |

Issue acceptance: growth is linear (×8 per decade), max < 1s at 10k — and the compaction pattern (pass after pass over grown history) drops from ~10s to ~0.2s. The instrumentation caveat from the issue applies to absolute numbers, not the ratio.

## Regression guard

`test/compaction/structured_ledger_perf_test.dart` (core suite, ~1.5s total, generous CI-jitter bounds): cold-build linearity (30× ratio + 3s sanity ceiling at 10k), bounded incremental-rebuild marathon (24 cached passes < 2.5s — the pre-fix shape runs ~10s), warm-vs-cold byte-equivalence, seq-move self-correction, `clear()`.

## Interplay with PR #1458 (issue #1380 total recall)

+/// One tool-use turn: user ask, assistant tool-call carrier, giant result.
+/// ~1.5 KB of text per turn — realistic file-read sizes, heavy enough that
+/// re-tokenizing history dominates any bookkeeping loop.
+List<SessionRecord> _turns(int count, {int startIndex = 0}) => [
+  for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) ..._turn(startIndex + i),
+];
+
+List<SessionRecord> _turn(int i) {
+  final resultText = 'x.dart:${'line $i content. ' * 44}';
+  return [
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-u',
+      parentId: i == 0 ? null : 'r${i - 1}-t',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: UserMessage.text('turn $i: inspect the failing module'),
+    ),
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-a',
+      parentId: 'r$i-u',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: AssistantMessage(
+        content: [
+          TextContent(text: 'reading the module for turn $i'),
+          ToolCall(
+            id: 'c$i',
+            name: 'read',
+            arguments: {'path': 'lib/mod$i.dart', 'why': 'turn $i'},
+          ),
+        ],
+        api: 'anthropic-messages',
+        provider: 'p',
+        model: 'm1',
+        usage: Usage.zero,
+        stopReason: StopReason.stop,
+        timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      ),
+    ),
+    MessageRecord(
+      id: 'r$i-t',
+      parentId: 'r$i-a',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      message: ToolResultMessage(
+        toolCallId: 'c$i',
+        toolName: 'read',
+        content: [TextContent(text: resultText)],
+        isError: false,
+        timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026),
+      ),
+    ),
+  ];
+}
+
+ContextLedger _build(List<SessionRecord> history, {LedgerEntryCache? cache}) =>
+    buildContextLedger(

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded

    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:

    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open

    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
